newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: BAI Mauritius interim 1996 profit up 9.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: BAI Mauritius interim 1996 profit up 9.0 pct.

text.p: Insurance firm British American Insurance (BAI) Mauritius posted on Tuesday a 9.0 percent rise in its profit before tax for the six months ending 30 June 1996.
Company officials reported a 21.2 million rupees profit before tax for BAI Mauritius during the first half of 1996, up from 19.3 million rupees in the corresponding 1995 period.

BAI Mauritius turnover was up 40 percent to 149.6 million rupees during the first half of 1996 from 106.9 million rupees for the first six months in 1995 while interim profit after tax rose to 21.4 million rupees from 19.3 million rupees.
For the year ending 31 December 1995, BAI Mauritius reported profit before tax of 36.4 million rupees on turnover of 234.1 million rupees and profit after tax of 36.4 million rupees.

BAI Mauritius, a subsidiary of the Bahamas-based British American Holdings Ltd, is one of the leading life insurance firms of Mauritius, with life business accounting for about 95 percent of its turnover.
Foreign expertise in the insurance business available to the Mauritian unit as part of a multinational concern, is a big bonus for the company, share analysts said.
